about: Sizes of the parts that go on a U heater, read on 16 Nov 2026 from her item drawings (Inventory → the item's drawing, as stored in the app) and from the inventory notes. A SNAPSHOT of 16 Nov 2026, never updated: on every sheet lib/drawings/partSizes.js reads the item's CURRENT inventory notes, and a size typed there wins over this file for that one field. All mm. lenMm = the part's length or thickness along the tube / pin axis (a bracket's: the 1.2 sheet of the upright the legs pass through; its foot is footLenMm). A note's own words are kept where the meaning is not stated. Owner, 16 Nov 2026: "you can also get the inventory's like finns and esb that is the ceramic bead, or any other material that goes onto the heater from the inventory for its dia and dimensions for accurate drawings".

ESB-08.shape: a plain ceramic ring, edges R0.2

ESB-11.shape: a plain ring chamfered 45° at BOTH ends to Ø9.9 — no head and no spigot; the sheet's material box says SS, the ESB is the ceramic bead (Ms. Vama, 16 Nov 2026)

NUT-SS-M4-08.shape: hex nut: 7.9 across corners, 6.8 across flats, 2.9 thick

NUT-BR-M4-08.shape: hex nut: 7.9 across corners, 6.8 across flats, 2.9 thick

PVC-FB11-M5.shape: Ø12.9 × 0.8 head, then a Ø10.1 spigot, 6.7 overall, bore Ø4.8
